name: Materials
pages: A piece's material sets its base uses, mana, repairs and highest spell level, and some materials change spells too. The style and the gem add to these.

pages.title: Wood Jewelry
pages.text: The weakest material. Found only as loot, and only in the regular style.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)2$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)40$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)20$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)0$()

pages.title: Iron Jewelry
pages.text: Very durable, and easy to repair.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)3$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)200$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)50$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)3$()$(br)$(l)Spell Duration:$() $(3)+25%$()

pages.title: Copper Jewelry
pages.text: A higher level than iron, but less durable.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)4$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)75$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)50$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)1$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cooldown:$() $(3)-5%$()

pages.title: Silver Jewelry
pages.text: Spells cost less mana.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)5$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)150$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)75$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)2$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cost:$() $(3)-5%$()

pages.title: Gold Jewelry
pages.text: The best of the common metals.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)6$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)150$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)100$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)2$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cost:$() $(3)-7.5%$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cooldown:$() $(3)-4%$()

pages.title: Bone Jewelry
pages.text: Spells are 25% stronger, but bone jewelry can't be repaired.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)7$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)200$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)50$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)0$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cost:$() $(3)+5%$()$(br)$(l)Spell Effect:$() $(3)+25%$()

pages.title: Blood Jewelry
pages.text: Blood (HemalSteel) is very rare: the Ring of Life and Death is the only piece made of it.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() $(4)8$()$(br)$(l)Uses:$() $(1)250$()$(br)$(l)Mana:$() $(1)100$()$(br)$(l)Repairs:$() $(6)2$()$(br)$(l)Spell Cost:$() $(3)-10%$()
